page.layout: One column of running text. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines "secundus in eâ putaretur" to "cap. 28:". Catchword "Pru-" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: exercitatione evadit melior, summo jure ac ratione exercitia militibus commendanda. Ea enim si probè calleant, facile eorum imperator ab hostibus victoriam est reportaturus. Sic enim referunt Attilam Gothorum Roderici filium Suecię regnum contra adversarios tutatum fuisse, quod militari disciplinæ, ita totum se traderet, ut suo tempore nulli secundusJoh. Ma-gnus Gothor. Hi-stor. l. 2. cap. 28: in eâ putaretur. Præsertim de exercendâ juventute Gothicâ, in omni exercitio militari continuè & prudenter cogitabat. Neque ullam pestem in quâcunque republicâ perniciosiorem reperiri posse credebat, quam si juventutem otiari, vel corruptis imbui moribus, permitteretur. Quo prudenti consilio tandem Danos, aliosque devicit, nec solū in propinquâ, sed & longinquâ militiâ conspicuus evasit.

page.notes: The printed page is 44, with the running head "P. VOET". The marginal note is set in small type in the left margin; its line breaks are kept by the hyphens, and "Gothor." is written whole because the line ends with "Go" and no hyphen is printed. The paragraph runs over from the previous page and continues to the catchword "Pru-". No doubtful readings. The faint mark at the lower right is a digitiser's watermark and is not transcribed.
